name: mcp-remote-chrome-extension
description: Control your real Chrome browser from any MCP client through a local bridge and a Manifest V3 extension.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @mcp-remote-chrome/server && npm run build --workspace @mcp-remote-chrome/extension
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/mcp.test.mjs tests/e2e.test.mjs
